Indico Developments · Request for quotation · Package 01

Aluminium windows and sliding doors

Katembe Ocean Views, Katembe, Maputo, Mozambique. A building with 12 T3, 3 T2 and 2 compact T2 apartments, a restaurant on floor 4, a supermarket, parking, a club house and a pool.

The plans below show where every item goes, with sizes from the architect's model. The table at the end lists each item, its specification and the quantity to price.

What we need from you

  1. A price per item number (supply only, and supply and install if you offer it).
  2. Lead time and stock availability.
  3. Delivery to Maputo, or collection in Johannesburg.
  4. Quote validity, payment terms and warranty.
  5. Alternatives you recommend, marked as alternatives.

Types, sizes and specification

One elevation per type, seen from outside for windows and sliding doors, all drawn to the same scale. Sizes in mm. Where the operation says "proposed" it is our intent: confirm it or propose your standard.

Aluminium sliding door: specification for every type below

SystemHeavy-duty aluminium sliding door system, coastal grade (lift-and-slide option welcome). State the system and series.
Leaves2 leaves: one sliding, one fixed, as drawn. Height 2 200 mm.
Frame finishPowder coated, matt black RAL 9005 (bronze option, colour to confirm). Seaside-class pretreatment.
GlassDouble glazed low-e, laminated safety glass both panes (SANS 10400-N).
HardwareMulti-point lock with key, stainless rollers, matt black flush pull handles.
ThresholdLow-profile threshold with drainage to the covered patio. Weather seals and brush seals.
Insect screenSliding fly screen, colour matched.
SmartPrepared for a wireless door sensor (LANBON LA-ADW1, supplied separately).

Aluminium window: specification for every type below

SystemCoastal-grade aluminium window system (e.g. Wispeco, AWS or equal), series to suit size and wind load. State the system and series in your quote.
OperationAs drawn on the elevation (proposed): wide windows 2 sliding sashes, standard windows side-hung casement, high or small windows top-hung. Confirm or propose.
Frame finishPowder coated, matt black RAL 9005 (bronze option, colour to confirm). Seaside-class pretreatment: the site is on Maputo bay.
GlassDouble glazed low-e unit (6 mm low-e + air + 6.38 laminated). Obscure glass in bathrooms and en-suites.
HardwareStainless steel 316: friction stays, restrictors on bedroom windows, handles matt black, multi-point lock on sliders.
Insect screenFly screen on every opening sash, frame colour matched.
Sill and fixingAluminium sub-sill with drip. Fixed with stainless screws and plugs at 500 mm, sealed with MS polymer inside and outside.
SizesStructural openings from the model, in mm. Check on site before manufacture.
